question: What museum can I find north of Basin Cove Overlook, Laurel Springs, NC, limited to 200 kilometers?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.20012 36.39093)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.20012 36.39093)',4326)::geography, 200000)
AND tourism = 'museum'
AND ((degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360));

answers.poi_name: Youth Museum of Southwestern West Virginia

[3].display_name: Basin Cove Overlook, Laurel Springs, NC

[4].direction_predicate: ((degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360))
